scientific_integrity.claim_basis: Uniform analytic proof from the exact competitor bound and an adjacent-pair distortion lower bound; finite checks are supplemental only.

scientific_limitations: Restricted to permutations of the prescribed initial dyadic masses, one-dimensional support, and squared-error quantization.
No claim is made for arbitrary initial weights; the motivating source records failure beyond its permutation class.
A residual originality risk remains for an unindexed or differently phrased proof.
title: Resolution of the dyadic-permutation quantization conjecture
